sources.provider: Google Research / Google Cloud Public Datasets; ERA5 by ECMWF Copernicus Climate Change Service
sources.format: Zarr store on Google Cloud Storage
sources.grid: 0.25 degree global grid; hourly time coordinate
sources.update_frequency: Stable ERA5 monthly with about a three-month delay; ERA5T preliminary data update more frequently
sources.access_conditions: Anonymous public GCS reads; metadata is small, but field chunks are large and should be subsetted before processing.
sources.licence: The data follow the Copernicus Licence to Use Copernicus Products; the ARCO repository code has a separate Apache-2.0 licence.
sources.attribution: Cite ARCO-ERA5 and the underlying ERA5/Copernicus Climate Change Service as described in the project README.
known_limitations: ERA5 is a reanalysis, not observation truth; ERA5T is preliminary.
The root metadata observed 2026-10-15 reports stable valid_time_stop 2026-06-30 and valid_time_stop_era5t 2026-10-09.
total_precipitation is stored in metres; accumulation and forecast-step semantics must be checked before deriving rates.
The store path suffix says zarr-v3, while the observed root exposes .zgroup/.zattrs/.zmetadata; use the store metadata rather than inferring the Zarr format from its name.

sources.provider: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Prediction via NOAA Open Data Dissemination and AWS
sources.format: GRIB2 forecast products and related NetCDF/NEMSIO objects
sources.crs: Global model grid; inspect each GRIB message for grid definition
sources.grid: Operational GFS; resolution and fields vary by product and lead time
sources.update_frequency: Four model cycles per day at 00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC
sources.access_conditions: Anonymous S3 listing/read; no AWS account required according to the AWS Open Data Registry.
sources.licence: NOAA NODD data are public; the registry requests attribution and prohibits implying NOAA endorsement.
sources.attribution: Attribute unaltered NOAA data to NOAA and do not imply endorsement.
known_limitations: A bucket listing does not prove every forecast field or run is complete.
The adapter must wait for all required forecast hours before publishing a run.
The current forecast file layout and GRIB parameter inventory must be verified by the adapter.

sources.format: S3 bucket candidate; layout not established
sources.access_conditions: Anonymous bucket listing responded, but returned zero keys on 2026-10-15.
sources.licence: Not verified for this empty candidate bucket; use the current BDP bucket instead.
sources.attribution: Not applicable until a usable product is found.
known_limitations: Empty at the time checked; do not use as a source.

sources.provider: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
sources.crs: Latitude/longitude; coordinates are columns in the CSV
sources.grid: Storm track points; no regular grid
sources.update_frequency: Version 4r01 is updated three times per week, usually Sunday, Tuesday, and Thursday.

variables.name: agency-specific track position, wind, and pressure columns
variables.unit: varies by agency column; retain agency and unit metadata

sources.access_conditions: Public HTTPS download; optional user registration is requested by NCEI but not required for direct download.
sources.licence: The product page provides citation requirements but no standard licence identifier; confirm redistribution terms before republishing data.
sources.attribution: Cite the IBTrACS v04r01 dataset and Knapp et al. (2010); record access date and subset used.
known_limitations: This is a multi-agency best-track archive, not a forecast.
CSV blank cells represent missing values; do not coerce them to zero.
Agency values and wind averaging conventions differ.

sources.provider: National Disaster Management Authority, Government of India
sources.format: HTML RSS subscription page; exact feed URL and payload not yet identified
sources.crs: Unknown; page advertises national and state alert subscriptions
sources.grid: Alert polygons/geocodes vary by CAP record; not yet inspected
sources.update_frequency: Official alert updates; exact polling schedule not stated
sources.access_conditions: The public page is reachable. Its visible RSS link points back to the subscription page; an agency integration guide is linked.
sources.licence: No reuse terms were verified from the reachable page; review the official guide/terms before automated ingestion.
sources.attribution: Preserve the issuing agency and CAP source text when/if a feed is verified.
known_limitations: The exact RSS/CAP feed URL is unresolved; do not scrape guessed endpoints.

sources.access_conditions: POST JSON with an X-API-Key header; up to 10 URLs per request. Documentation states a free daily allowance up to 1,000 successfully fetched URLs; wallet billing may apply beyond the allowance.
sources.licence: TinyFish API terms and target-site terms both apply; verify before each target integration.
sources.attribution: Retain source URL, retrieval time, and extracted source provenance.
known_limitations: No TINYFISH_API_KEY was configured during this check; no live API call was made.

sources.format: OpenStreetMap database and extracts; format depends on chosen download service
sources.crs: Typically WGS 84 coordinates; check extract metadata
sources.grid: Vector features; coverage and completeness vary by place and feature type
sources.update_frequency: Continuously edited; extract cadence depends on provider
sources.access_conditions: Data can be reused under ODbL with required attribution; OSM tile, API, and Nominatim services have separate usage policies and are not unrestricted bulk-download services.
sources.licence: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0
sources.attribution: Display OpenStreetMap and its contributors and link to the copyright/licence notice.
known_limitations: No study-area extract or individual facility dataset has been selected or downloaded.
